To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we can iteratively improve machine translation output by making a small number of modifications to the output of an existing system, and that we can do so by parameterizing our system with a convolutional neural net.
we present an attention-based model that makes iterative improvements to a given translation, and that we improve phrase-based machine translation by up to 2.4 BLEU.

(1) iterative refinement is a promising direction for machine translation; (2) the model can be trained end-to-end using standard supervised learning; (3) the model is effective even when it is applied only a few times to the initial translation; (4) the model can also be applied to other types of translation systems; and (5) the model is robust to the choice of the attention mechanism

the following question: Can we improve the translation quality of a given machine translation system by revisiting previous decisions?
